subject.title: [Bug]: v2026.6.9 regression — Codex app-server runs stamp internal turns "webchat"-bound, so heartbeat notification sends to Discord are silently denied (cross-context)

question: Which open fix path should maintainers treat as canonical for the Codex internal-turn webchat binding regression?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and has multiple open closing PRs with different scope: one narrow reviewed candidate, one broader diagnostics candidate, and one narrower incomplete attempt, so cleanup should wait for a human canonical-path choice or merge.

options.title: Land the narrow reviewed fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102232 as the primary fix path because the current review says it covers the webchat/webchat internal-turn shape while preserving real WebChat user containment.

options.title: Adopt the broader diagnostics PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102217 only if maintainers want the delivery fix bundled with the new diagnostic event and repro script after its current-head review blockers are cleared.

options.title: Request a replacement
options.body: Close or pause the overlapping PRs and ask for one maintainer-owned replacement if neither branch has the desired scope.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow reviewed fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102232 as the primary fix path because the current review says it covers the webchat/webchat internal-turn shape while preserving real WebChat user containment.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice spans the outbound cross-context policy invariant and the operator-visible handling of denied sends.
